name: Midnight at Circle K
source:
A guy comes home late from work. And he decided to visit Circle K, a 24/7 convenience store in Vietnam...Thought everything was nothing special, but a man approached him.

[From [url=https://don-hi.itch.io/midnight-at-circle-k]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个男人下班后很晚才回家。他决定去Circle K——越南一家24小时营业的便利店……他本以为一切都很平常，却有个男人走上前来。

[来源：[url=https://don-hi.itch.io/midnight-at-circle-k]Itch.io[/url]]
